From Lovers · Price: damage to you is also shared with the host.

Theme Affliction

  • 1: 2 actions: link with a creature by touch for 1 minute (@Check[will|against:stand]{Will} negates). When you take damage, it takes half that much, up to @Damage[(1+floor((@actor.level - 1)/4))d6[force]] (no save).
  • 5: When you heal, it doesn't heal.
  • 9: Surge: you transfer one condition from you to the host (@Check[will|against:stand]{Will} negates).
  • 13: Link two creatures.
  • 17: The cap rises to @Damage[(2*ceil(@actor.level/2))d6[force]].

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC.
